turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
When an action is finished, the verb changes.
Look: Today I climb. Yesterday I climbed. We add -ed after a regular verb to talk about a finished action.
Right: He listened to music. Wrong: He listen to music yesterday.
Now you try. Write the verb: Yesterday we (wait) for the bus.
